periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Delivered four suicide prevention trainings to 86 school counselors, Parks staff and residents. Certified two Public Health staff as trainers. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold a large school staff session before the school year ends and schedule a session for port employees.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Delivered seven trainings, including a large school staff session in May, bringing the total trained to 151. Booked summer sessions for seaport supervisors and school bus drivers. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Harborview Unified School District, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Train seaport supervisors and school bus drivers, and keep post-test gains above 20 points.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Delivered 9 suicide prevention trainings, the busiest quarter so far, including a session for seaport supervisors and one for school bus drivers. 214 people have now completed training this year, and post-test gains averaged 23 points. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Harborview Unified School District, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold two trainings for faith leaders and one for library staff, and certify four additional staff as in-house trainers.
